messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `redwood-runtime-az1` - INC-9213 — elevated 5xx rate and p99 latency spike. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-9213
PagerDuty: Automated notification: routing to primary oncall Alice Chen per az1-runtime-sre escalation policy.
Alice Chen: ack — I'm on it. Looking at metrics and logs now.
Alice Chen: Initial triage: spike started ~00:07 UTC. 5xx rate ~18% on inference-proxy, p99 latency up from ~120ms -> ~800ms. Traffic still being routed to az1.
Bob Patel: joining oncall. grabbing logs + core dumps. Any recent deploys?
Alice Chen: No deploys in the last 30m. Noticed kvcache eviction rate increasing and pod oom events on several inferencer pods. Suspect NIC/retransmit issues.
Carol Jones: I'm seeing a burst of retransmits and carrier events on fabric in az1. Interfaces eth0 on shard-az1-13 and shard-az1-14 showing errors. Pasting `ethtool -S` excerpt:
```
RX_ERRORS: 1245
TX_ERRORS: 0
RX_OVERRUN: 0
rx_nohandler: 18
```
Dinesh Kumar: I can flip routing to az2 if we want immediate relief. Also can scale reserved capacity in az2. Recommend fallback to az2 + model-variant fallback for non-critical traffic to reduce pressure.
incident-bot: Autoscaler: detected reduced available capacity in az1 nodegroup (30% less schedulable) due to OOM kills on inferencer pods.
Alice Chen: Plan: 1) Activate routing fallback to az2 for affected model group. 2) Enable model_variant `gpt-3.5-quant-fallback` (CPU/quantized variant) for non-critical customers to reduce GPU pressure. Carol/Bob please cordon affected nodes.
Bob Patel: on it — cordoning shard-az1-13 and shard-az1-14 and draining pods. Command: `kubectl cordon shard-az1-13 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data shard-az1-13`
Carol Jones: cordoned both nodes, draining in progress. Eviction logs show `kvcache` corruption on inferencer-23 prior to OOM. Saving core dumps to /var/logs/cores for forensics.
ops-bot: Deploybot: Canary rollout started for `gpt-3.5-quant-fallback` — 20% traffic -> will ramp to 100% in 5m if no errors.
Alice Chen: Escalating to SRE lead @Eve Morales for customer impact assessment. Declaring Sev2: customers may see intermittent 5xxs or higher latency for generation calls in us-west-az1.
Eve Morales: Acknowledged. I'll notify support & prepare status update.
Eve Morales: Status page draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates in us-west-az1 affecting inference requests. We have activated automatic fallback to alternate zone and model variants. Some customers may experience higher latency or degraded quality. We will update as mitigation progresses."
Alice Chen: Traffic shift to az2 in progress — currently ~45% of affected model traffic routed to az2. Error rate down to ~6% from 18%. p99 latency ~300ms and trending down.
Dinesh Kumar: Scaling up dedicated pool in az2 by +10 GPUs (reserving burst capacity). ETA ~3m.
Bob Patel: Flushed prefix cache to avoid stale entries during migration: `redwoodctl cache flush --zone=az1 --model=gpt-3.5-quant`
Carol Jones: Confirmed kvcache migrations completed for drained pods. Core analysis: observed kernel-level oops pattern consistent with known NIC driver bug under heavy kvm mappings.
Alice Chen: Adding mitigation notes to PD. Requesting no further on-call escalations; handing back to platform oncall after stabilization.
Eve Morales: Support notified in #support-public with status page link.
Bob Patel: Will own postmortem and follow-up. Immediate next steps: schedule rolling kernel upgrade for az1 during off-peak, validate kvm mapping limits, and publish postmortem draft in 48h.
Alice Chen: Incident status -> stabilizing. PD INC-9213 set to acknowledged/mitigated. Leaving follow-ups for Bob (postmortem) and Dinesh (capacity validation).
Bob Patel: :thumbsup: Taking postmortem ownership. Draft ETA 48h.
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-9213 status changed to Resolved (closed by Alice Chen).
Alice Chen: Thanks all — switching to follow-up mode. I'll post the postmortem link here when ready. :heart:
